name: Sau chit
summary: Sâu chít is a plump, milk-white worm taken from the stem of the chít plant. It is kept in weak wine, then steeped into a wine or cooked into porridge.
howToEat: Split the chít stem, take the worm, and put it in a basin of weak wine so it does not change. Vietnamnet then says it is steeped as wine or cooked as porridge.
seoTitle: Sau chit in Dien Bien Phu — wine or porridge
seoDescription: Sâu chít is a plump, milk-white worm taken from the stem of the chít plant.
